title: QA Workbench Evidence Link
description: Schema for a structured evidence reference attached to a QA workbench item. Each link records which evidence artifact supports or relates to the QA finding, what produced it, and why it was attached. Evidence links are advisory-only — they do not prove defect validity, imply Owner approval, or confer seal authority.

evidence_ref.description: Reference to the evidence artifact (packet ID, receipt ID, etc.).

source_path.description: Optional filesystem path to the evidence artifact within the QA Pilot project.

producing_validator.description: Name of the validator script that produced or validated this evidence.

producing_command.description: CLI command used to produce this evidence.

attachment_reason.description: Short rationale for why this evidence is linked to the QA item.

custody.description: Must always be qa-pilot-local. Evidence links cannot claim cross-project or Librarian custody.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Evidence links are advisory-only and never confer seal or approval authority.

authority_note.const: Evidence attachment does not prove defect validity or imply Owner approval.
authority_note.description: Standard authority disclaimer attached to every evidence link.

attached_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence link was attached.
